sources: ICRSP France per-day source URL and its H3 Commentaires author/editorial panels
Existing seven Ad Orientem Mass Scripture source-path owner registries from B09
distinction: This is 40 article-level introductory/selected commentary passage inspections, not exhaustive review of all historical authors, sections, source editions or copyright permissions.
controls: All 40 have actual ICRSP commentary source pages inspected for named substantive themes; unchanged source URL and index position retained.
Do not describe a page's first Guéranger passage as every Schuster or Parsch panel having been fully read.
When same day has station, Scripture and historical themes, preserve the strongest demonstrated theme as a research candidate; no invented Scripture quotation or editorial voice.
The 51/51 completion ratio describes first-pass topic-level page inspection, NOT unique historical work text collation, critical historical verification, full source rights review or proved app gaps.
Roman stations are local historical contextual leads for existing Calendar; no second Church map or 1962 liturgical ceremony implementation.
Biblical typology must join the separate authenticated Scripture parallels compendium outside chronology, not rewritten Historia Salutis narrative.
Historical polemic about Jews and Israel must never be projected as universal doctrinal facts; preserve era/author context and prefer primary doctrinal guidance.
No original text quotation, no French commentary prose copy and no user-facing feature created.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / station opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Roman station at Santa Anastasia; the church is also connected with the Roman Christmas dawn Mass.
rows.editorialCaution: Church/feast association must be independently checked before linking a canonical place ID.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / Quatre-Temps opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Lenten Ember Wednesday: fasting, the consecration of spring, and historical association with prayers for priestly ordinations.
rows.editorialCaution: Historical fasting/ordination statements cannot establish 1962 practice or current obligation.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / Station and LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Station at San Lorenzo in Panisperna; Ezekiel's insistence on personal moral responsibility and mercy toward converts.
rows.editorialCaution: Verify historical station name spelling and chapter/verse independently.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / Station and LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Ember Friday station at Santi Apostoli; public-penitent reconciliation imagery linked to the Ezekiel lesson.
rows.editorialCaution: Public penance rites are historical explanation, not present-day congregational actions.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / Station
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Station at San Clemente: Roman basilica and martyr associations; the day's typological scriptural application requires fuller passage comparison.
rows.editorialCaution: Do not treat saint burial/patronage descriptions as verified archaeological record.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / Station and LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Station at Santa Balbina; Elijah and catechumenal Old Testament–New Testament fulfilment themes.
rows.editorialCaution: Nineteenth-century supersessionist interpretations require theological contextualization.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / LEÇON and ÉVANGILE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Jeremiah's fruitful tree and desolate shrub paired with Luke's rich man and Lazarus; divine judgement and conversion.
rows.editorialCaution: Reading references and any historic claims must be checked against actual 1962 source sections.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / LEÇON and ÉVANGILE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Joseph sold by his brothers presented as a figure of Christ; the wicked-tenants parable interpreted in connection with the Passion.
rows.editorialCaution: Original rhetoric about the Jewish people is period-specific and must not be adopted uncritically.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / LEÇON and ÉVANGILE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Jacob and Esau placed alongside the return of the prodigal son; grace, paternal mercy and an older Israel/Gentile interpretation.
rows.editorialCaution: The national/supersessionist reading requires contextualisation; no generic replacement theology summaries.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Naaman's cleansing in Jordan as a figure of baptism; Roman station at San Marco.
rows.editorialCaution: A prefiguration candidate, not a new Bible passage translation or invented patristic quotation.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / LEÇON and ÉVANGILE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Widow's miraculous supply of oil interpreted through works of mercy and neighbourly forgiveness; station at Santa Pudenziana.
rows.editorialCaution: Separate biblical facts from the commentator's devotional application.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Roman station at San Sisto Vecchio; Mosaic commands to respect one's neighbour linked to Christ's teaching on charity.
rows.editorialCaution: Avoid interpreting all ancient Roman biographical traditions as independently documented facts.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / mid-Lent opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Saints Cosmas and Damian Roman station and the historical idea of a mid-Lent fasting milestone.
rows.editorialCaution: Do not prescribe nineteenth-century fasting customs as modern or universally binding in 1962.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Chaste Susanna contrasted with the woman rescued by Christ, and Susanna as a figure of persecuted Christian fidelity.
rows.editorialCaution: Attributed Hippolytus/catacomb iconography needs original textual and art-historical verification.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Solomon's judgement between two mothers read typologically as an image of the Church as mother.
rows.editorialCaution: The passage's historical Israel/Gentile polemic must not become user-facing blanket claims.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Golden-calf idolatry taught in connection with Lenten instruction and preparation of catechumens; station at San Lorenzo in Damaso.
rows.editorialCaution: Verify its precise Mass lesson in current 1962 Proper and distinguish church history from rubric.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Elisha raising the Shunammite's child read as a type of Christ restoring life; station at Santi Silvestro e Martino ai Monti.
rows.editorialCaution: Treat the typology as sourced commentary, not a direct biblical assertion by a Father.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Elijah and the widow of Zarephath's revived son as anticipatory images of Christ's life-giving power and baptism.
rows.editorialCaution: Related to Elisha topic previous day: thematic duplicate family, keep different passages.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Sitientes Saturday: Isaiah's invitation to waters interpreted as baptismal preparation; disputed historical station relocations.
rows.editorialCaution: The site's two accounts differ on original station (San Lorenzo in Lucina vs San Lorenzo fuori le Mura); preserve source conflict.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / ÉPÎTRE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Nineveh's penitence, repentance and the Lord's mercy presented to ancient catechumens; station at San Crisogono.
rows.editorialCaution: Passion Week source scope must be checked; no novel 1962 fasting directives.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / LEÇON
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Daniel among the lions interpreted alongside the witness of early Christian martyrs and catacomb images.
rows.editorialCaution: Claims about precise age/distribution of catacomb imagery require archaeological reference.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / LEÇON and ÉVANGILE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Leviticus' commands of justice and neighbour-love set beside Johannine testimony about Christ's works.
rows.editorialCaution: Confirm biblical loci from existing exact sourcePath before a Scripture parallel is certified.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / opening on pre-Holy Week Saturday
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Ancient Rome's pre-Holy-Week papal fermentum Eucharistic distribution and almsgiving, associated with a Saturday lacking a Roman station.
rows.editorialCaution: Not a modern 1962 Mass rite or a basis for priest gestures; historic scholarship needs source collation.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / Sunday opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Historical shift of Gospel pericopes across post-Pentecost Sundays while many chants, collects and epistles retained older assignments.
rows.editorialCaution: Historical reconstruction, not permission to exchange 1962 Propers.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: David's accession and the promised Davidic kingship associated with Office readings and the figure of the Messiah.
rows.editorialCaution: Distinguish Office-month-dependent readings from the Mass's actual epistle or gospel.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: David's repentance after his sin as a pattern of contrition and dependence on grace in the post-Pentecost context.
rows.editorialCaution: Avoid overextending christological analogy from David's personal sin.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / opening and ÉPÎTRE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Wisdom theme drawn from varying summer Office books and the epistle's teaching on baptism and life in Christ.
rows.editorialCaution: Office book depends on calendar month; do not automatically project it into every 1962 Sunday.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / early historical introduction
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Historical meditation on Jerusalem before its destruction with Josephus and Gospel eschatology.
rows.editorialCaution: Historic claims, dates and Jewish–Christian polemics require independent checking and contextualisation.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / historical introduction
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Roman siege of Jerusalem framed through Gospel warnings, historical military movements and prophetic interpretation.
rows.editorialCaution: Not a neutral modern historical account; reject direct adoption of anti-Jewish polemical framing.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / opening and A LA MESSE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Older assignment of the Publican and Pharisee Gospel shifted to the previous Sunday; humility connected with the epistle and collect.
rows.editorialCaution: Existing 1962 owner governs Gospel identity; old lectionary arrangement is historical only.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / A LA MESSE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Good Samaritan Sunday paired with Psalm 69's cry for assistance and Cassian's prayer tradition.
rows.editorialCaution: Cassian and medieval rubric/lesson attributions need authentic original-work citation.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / A LA MESSE and ÉPÎTRE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Two masters Gospel and Paul's contrast between flesh and Spirit; the Church as Bride in the chant commentary.
rows.editorialCaution: Differentiate liturgical source reading from later theological interpretation.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / ÉPÎTRE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Galatians' warnings against vainglory and spiritual pride set within the Sunday's prayer and epistle.
rows.editorialCaution: Generic moral teaching may already be in Formation; only feast-specific source connection merits proposal.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / ÉPÎTRE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Ephesians' prayer that Christ dwell in the heart through faith and charity; the Church's petition for grace.
rows.editorialCaution: Original author and biblical location required before direct quotation.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Great commandment of love and the Gospel's older Sunday position in western lectionaries.
rows.editorialCaution: Old Gospel assignment does not change 1962 liturgical selection.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / ÉPÎTRE
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Paul's teaching in Ephesians on putting on the new man, linked with collect motifs carried from the preceding Sunday.
rows.editorialCaution: Claims about collection of Sunday prayers need exact historic missal witness.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Late Pentecost season's Gentile and Israel imagery, interpreted in a strongly historic nineteenth-century theology of the Church.
rows.editorialCaution: High editorial sensitivity: historical polemic must not be presented as doctrinal fact.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / Offertory and Collect context
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Job imagery in the Offertory and Mordecai's supplication as an end-of-year liturgical motif.
rows.editorialCaution: Check the actually displayed 1962 chants and Vulgate Esther context independently.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Dom Guéranger / ÉPÎTRE and Collect
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Paul's Epistle to the Philippians and Gospel duty to forgive debts framed as preparation for the day of Christ.
rows.editorialCaution: Avoid making editorial devotional inference into a new Gospel-to-Epistle source rule.

rows.sourceSubsectionLocator: Commentaires / Présentation and Dom Guéranger / opening
rows.oneSourceGroundedTheme: Final weeks' historic shift between twenty-third and last-Sunday Masses, with chant inheritance from prior Sunday.
rows.editorialCaution: Actual 1962 last-Sunday/rubric decisions remain with existing Calendar and Proper resolver.
